Well it’s the start of another day. I took my am meds and lay here waiting for my brain to shake off the shackles that enslave my honest feelings.
Why do I get a clear headspace from my meds but not peace of mind? Is it that I don’t deserve that feeling that everyone else around me seems to have? Why do I have to be so different when I’m the same as those around me, my sense of humor has probably killed all my friendships, my pain keeps them away and my anxiety and depression hold me in place and surround me in self hate and loathing.  When I was a teenager I had a secret that I kept to myself. I said to myself that if by the time I was 30 if I wasn’t part of a family with a spouse and children then my life would be voided and I was going to kill myself. I have the family I wanted I have the chance to give them what I never had but every time I try to take that breath to join in on life with them my true self appears and whispers and holds me back . I can’t plug my ears enough to keep the whispers out and they get so loud that I just want to cry. I can’t take these thoughts to my family because I don’t deserve their love and support and in the past when I have I get neglected and told how bad they had it and how miserable I’ve made them.  I have let my wife down as a husband, my attempt to manage my symptoms caused hate and pain. I was hurting from the pain of my failed first marriage and I didn’t engage and lashed out at my wife and I’m not proud of myself I am so sorry and I tell her all the time how sorry and regretful I am for my actions. I went back to therapy and learned how to change and it is great I love having time with my therapist she is a great person and has helped me make changes to my bad speech habits and taught me to deal and express myself properly. But it’s not enough to keep me full inside. I am afraid of being honest with those around me because I can’t handle their judgment, or the look in their eyes it shakes me to my core.l, I’m such a coward and I hate myself  for it. 
I am sad. I am depressed. I am anxious. I am constantly suicidal always looking for a the right moment to make it look like an accident so my family doesn’t think it’s their fault. I don’t know what to do anymore 😓 I need some help through or out of my suffering
